title: Second Largest Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N, Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9; For type-1 queries, 1 \leq p \leq N.; For type-1 queries, 1 \leq x \leq 10^9.; For type-2 queries, 1 \leq l \leq r \leq N.; There is at least one type-2 query.; All input values are integers.
